title: Re-Pin Proof Cockpit Machine Evidence
description: Convenience command that regenerates the proof-cockpit machine-QA evidence and promotes it, re-pinning the committed evidence to the current commit so the acceptance gate is fresh after scoped source changes.
purpose: Give developers a single command to regenerate and re-pin proof-cockpit machine evidence when scoped source, compose, or catalogue files change, so the fail-closed acceptance freshness gate returns to green before merge.
outputs: Regenerated machine-QA run artifacts under artifacts/proof-cockpit/machine-runs
Updated evidence/proof-evidence/proof-cockpit/staging-evidence-store.json pinned to the current commit
Guidance to commit the regenerated evidence on standard output
sideEffects: Runs the Playwright machine-QA harness against the proof cockpit and writes run artifacts
Promotes the newest run into the committed evidence store and prunes superseded run payloads
failureSemantics: Fails closed if the machine-QA run reports failures, warnings, or gaps, or if promotion cannot resolve the newest run; a failed re-pin leaves the committed evidence unchanged and does not itself commit. It records hermetic, synthetic proof evidence only and upgrades no readiness claim.
aiGuidance: Use this command to re-pin proof-cockpit machine evidence to the current commit after changing scoped source, compose, or catalogue files, then commit the regenerated evidence. It records hermetic synthetic evidence only; do not treat a successful re-pin as human acceptance or as any staging, deployment, or production readiness claim.
